sense.text:
“The burden of the word of the Lord in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof”: write this down, Hadrach and Damascus is Syria, modern day Syria. There will be a judgment that falls upon Syria, as some of us are seeing in the news today; God has promised to bring judgment upon the land of Syria.

“When the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the Lord”: all our eyes should be towards the Lord. Now we’re looking for the Lord to return; we see the signs in the sun and the moon, we see distress of nations.

precepts.why:
Christ gave us some key factors regarding his second coming. “And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon”: they had a super moon, a blood moon, an eclipse; we’re seeing signs in the sun and the moon. “And in the stars”: constellations, shooting stars. “And upon the earth distress of nations”: that’s what we’re seeing now, distress of nations between Ukraine and Russia, Palestine and the modern state of Israel, China threatening to attack Taiwan.

“Men’s hearts failing them for fear”: that’s what we’re seeing also. “And for looking after those things which are coming on the earth”: more things are going to happen on this earth, worse than we can imagine, worse than what the people see currently. “For the powers of heaven shall be shaken”: that means war. This is war.

“And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.” Christ said when you see all these things taking place, then you’re going to see the sign of the Son of man coming in all power and glory. “Then look up, and lift up your heads”: that’s what we just read in Zechariah 9, when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the Lord. “For your redemption draweth nigh”: brothers, sisters, all we can say is our redemption is near.

sense.text:
“And Hamath also”: write this down, Hamath also is Syria. “Shall border thereby”: Syria borders Tyrus and Zidon, which is Lebanon.

But listen good: this Tyrus and Zidon is a metaphor for the United States of America. That might shock some of you, because modern day Tyre and Zidon is modern day Lebanon, but notice the wording: “Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.” There was a time back in the day it was a wise nation, but today it’s not. That’s the part, though it be very wise; that’s why we went to Ezekiel 28.

“And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust”: talking about riches. “And fine gold as the mire of the streets”: they’ve got fine gold like the mire, the dirt on the street. That’s not talking about modern day Lebanon; modern day Lebanon does not fit what we’re reading here.

What is the stronghold America has built? The stronghold Tyrus has built is Israel. Israel is a stronghold in the Middle East; that’s why the USA supports Israel, and everybody always asks what the relationship is between America and Israel. America has built up Israel’s military: America has bases all throughout Israel; that’s the stronghold they have. America has built a stronghold over there. So America herself is a stronghold, and she has built one in the Middle East.

The question might be, how do we know it’s not modern day Lebanon? Lebanon ranked 112th in prosperity, so this ain’t the place that heaped up silver and gold. Lebanon is broke, and their military ain’t up to par with America or Israel’s. That’s how we know.

And America signed the largest ever military aid deal with Israel: $3.8 billion annually, that’s yearly. 3.8 billion, damn. That was in 2016; I’m sure they amped it up by now. Washington’s largest defense aid package to any country in history. Israel has become a stronghold over in the Middle East; America built that thing up.

“Behold, the Lord will cast her out”: the Lord is going to cast America out, and his stronghold out. “And he will smite her power in the sea”: that’s their Marines, their military; it’s what we read in Jeremiah 49 about the Red Sea, the smiting of their military. The Most High is giving us a map of what’s going to happen. “And she shall be devoured with fire.”

The nations are waking up to the evils of the world. He called the United States a devil nation to his face, and Israel too is a devil nation; that’s some heavy stuff right there. The only one that ain’t woke up to that is the Christian negro today; they ain’t woke up to nothing.

precepts.why:
This shows that Tyrus is a metaphor for America today, the nation that is “wiser than Daniel.”

“Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus”: that’s Lebanon, but let’s see. “Because thine heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God”: this is Edom; this is not modern day Lebanon. “In the midst of the seas”: America’s military bases are in the midst of the seas, globally, worldwide. So this is not talking about modern day Lebanon.

“Yet thou art a man, and not God”: you’re not a God, you are a man, the prophecy says. “Though thou set thine heart as the heart of God”: the mindset of America, the mindset of today’s modern white man, is that he is God on earth.

“Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel”: the prophecy says that about Tyrus, which is a metaphor for America, this white man here. “There is no secret that they can hide from thee”: their technology. There’s no secret you can hide from the United States of America. Those cell phones everybody’s got, you think that was for your benefit? No, that’s for them to keep eyes and ears on all of us; it’s a monitoring system. These smart TVs, YouTube, social media: all of these are monitoring systems, to monitor the public, who’s saying what. Telegram: they’re trying to sue them now to open up Telegram so America can get their grimy hands in there. All that’s Amalek too. The white man will go so far he will put a camera in the butt of an ant to find out what makes an ant tick; they put monitoring systems on sharks and eagles, all kinds of animals. They want to know everything.

“With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures”: this is America, the richest country on earth. Y’all better understand America is not broke. There is no deficit; hell, they print money, talking about they broke. No, they’re not. “By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches”: traffick means trade. “And thine heart is lifted up.”
To talk about he will smite her power in the sea: “Thus saith the Lord God to Tyrus”. The word is to Tyrus.

“And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited of seafaring men”: that’s their Marines, that’s their naval power. This Tyrus is a metaphor, because Tyrus, when you check it out geographically, is Lebanon, and Lebanon is low; they cannot match the United States of America. “The renowned city”: meaning famous city, “which wast strong in the sea”. “She and her inhabitants, which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it”: America causes their terror to be on all that haunt it, not modern day Lebanon. Their military, their Navy, is everywhere, causing terror wherever they go.

“Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall”: when America falls the isles are going to tremble. “When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited”: that’s the fall of Babylon. “When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time”: just like the people of old time. “That thou be not inhabited”: nobody’s ever going to live here again. “And I shall set glory in the land of the living”: that’s the Israelites; that’s going to be over in Jerusalem.

“I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt be no more”: America’s a terror, and it shall be no more. “Though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord God”: that’s how you know this is a metaphor for America, the America of Revelation 18. This is the place that’s never going to be inhabited, and these people are never going to be found again. That’s how we know this Tyrus is talking about Esau of America.

“Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman”: the inhabitants of Teman is still talking about America. The Bible uses code words. “Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out”: the least of the flock is Israel. “Surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them”: because when Israel goes to war, America’s going to go to war. Whoever strikes Israel, America must support them; that’s Ezekiel 35, which tells about the relationship between those two countries.

And the trick bag is this: Turkey wants to hit Israel, but Turkey is a member of NATO, and the NATO contract is if you attack one of us you attack all of us. So if Turkey attacks Israel, according to the contract America is supposed to support Turkey. But America will not support Turkey; America will fight against Turkey, breaking the NATO agreement, to protect Israel. It’s a trick bag, brothers. The Most High got him set up.

“The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea”: there’s going to be war in the Red Sea. “Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle”: that’s America, coming like an eagle, we’re coming to protect Israel. “And spread his wings over Bozrah”: modern day, the West Bank, Jordan. “And at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs”: because America is going to fall. America will fall.

That is the smiting of her power in the sea in Zechariah 9:4, the smiting of their military by the Red Sea.

sense.text:
Put the map up: Ashkelon is right there in the land of Israel, right under Ashdod, right above the Gaza Strip, and Ekron right above Ashdod.

“Ashkelon shall see it, and fear”: the nations are going to see the fall of America in the sea. “Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful”: they’re going to see Israel getting wiped out. “And Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed”: they’re going to think America will save them, and it’s not going to happen. Their expectation was that America was going to save them; America ain’t going to be able to save their own selves. That Iron Dome is going to fail over there, the Iron Dome they brag about.

“And the king shall perish from Gaza”: they’re going to set up another leader over in Gaza; Esau is going to put a leader there, one of their people. “And Ashkelon shall not be inhabited”: that whole place is going to get wiped out. That’s what the Bible prophesies will happen.

“And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod”: the Bible says a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, right there. That lets you know they’re all Esau, the …; God is calling them bastards. Those are not his people.

“And I will cut off the pride of the Philistines”: the pride of the Philistines is Palestine. Palestine is the Philistines. God said he’s going to cut off the pride of the Palestinians; that’s what he’s going to do.

precepts.why: Doesn’t it call Esau bastard in Hebrews? “But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.”

“Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau”: because the one that has never been chastised yet is Esau. They’re the bastard; they’re the profane people. “Who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.”

“For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected”: God has rejected Esau, and not just him; all his people have been rejected. “For he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears”: there’s no place of repentance for Esau, Edom.

This shows how the Lord is going to cut off the pride of the Philistines, of the Palestinians.

“Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken”: modern day Israel has been smiting the Palestinians: the bombings of the Palestinian journalists, the rampant murdering and killings of women, children, innocent civilians. The rod of him that smote thee, the modern day Israelis, they’re going to be broken up over there. So God tells Palestine, don’t rejoice because I brought judgment on these modern day Israelis, these … here. “For out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent”: a missile will be on its way. God is letting them know, letting us know, the battle ain’t over yet; a missile will go out towards Palestine.

“And the firstborn of the poor shall feed”: that’s Christ. “And the needy shall lie down in safety”: we’re going to lie down in safety. “And I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.”

“Cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina”: God is telling the Palestinians you better cry. “Art dissolved”: there’s going to be a missile that’s going to wipe them out too. Because the land of Israel don’t belong to either of those two: it don’t belong to the … calling themselves Jewish, and it don’t belong to the Arabs calling themselves Palestinians. “For there shall come from the north a smoke”: America is going to shoot a missile. “And none shall be alone in his appointed times.”

“What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it”: Zion, the poor of God’s people. We shall trust in the words of this book; everything this book says, we must put our trust in it.

sense.text:
“And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth”: pause right there; we’ve got to go through that slow. There are two things behind that blood. Actually it’s sin, but it’s also literal blood, because eating blood is a sin.

There’s something called blood libel. I heard Candace Owens say this term and I had to look it up. They say it’s false that they use blood in the performance of religious ritual: don’t say that, that is anti-Semitic. So their message to us is, stop telling that lie; it’s not true, it has not been true, nor will it ever be true, that they drink, sip or taste blood. But didn’t we just read under the blood libel that they don’t do no religious rituals with blood? That’s a blood libel, it’s anti-Semitic, how dare y’all lie against us. But now look at what the New York City Health Department puts out about their ritual: so they’re anti-Semitic too. And babies are getting herpes from it. You know what that means: the guy doing that disgusting ritual already got the herpes, and he’s putting his herpes lips on the baby.

In the news report, look how happy and excited he is to put his mouth on the baby’s wiener. And it’s not just him that’s doing it; it’s a whole group of them that perform this. The way they edited it would make you think he’s against it, but he does it too: what he’s against is the herpes, not putting the mouth on the baby’s penis. They all do it; it’s part of their rituals. They say Judaism mandates it, a commandment: that is not in the scriptures, to suck the blood from a baby’s penis. These people are crazy. They must do it in a way that is sweet, meaning as long as the child is not hurt, as long as the child does not contract herpes, it’s sweet. You can’t make this up; this is some evil stuff, brothers. And for some they put a tube on the penis and suck the blood through the tube, like a straw. These people are insane, and y’all call these God’s chosen people, and the scripture says don’t taste, don’t eat, don’t sip on blood. Get your mouth off that penis. It’s part of the oral law, they say.

precepts.why:
Eating blood is a sin. “And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.”

“For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul. Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.” Even the beast or fowl that is hunted and caught, “he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.” “Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.”

That is the blood God will take out of his mouth: the scripture says don’t taste, don’t eat, don’t sip on blood, and these so-called chosen people suck the blood from a baby’s penis in their rituals.

Their ritual is part of the oral law, and the Wisdom of Solomon speaks of it. “Moreover this was not enough for them, that they erred in the knowledge of God”: nations have erred in the knowledge of God. “But whereas they lived in the great war of ignorance”: nations live in a great war of ignorance. “Those so great plagues called they peace”: they call it peace; they’re at peace in their ignorance, sucking baby penis.

“For whilst they slew their children in sacrifices”: that’s called abortion today. “Or used secret ceremonies”: they don’t let the public in on these; when they go in and suck the blood from the penis, that’s a secret ceremony. Just the families and those so-called rabbis take part in it.

sense.text:
“And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth”: that is these so-called Israelis who suck and drink blood. Yes you do; we just saw it. They say it is a blood libel, anti-Semitic, to say they use blood in their religious rituals, and then their own mohels put their mouths on the baby’s penis to suck the blood away, and spread herpes to the babies doing it, and they call it part of the oral law. That is not in the scriptures. The scripture says don’t taste, don’t eat, don’t sip on blood. And they speak evil against black people; yes you do, we just saw it and we just read it.

“But he that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God”: he that remaineth is us, our people. “And he shall be as a governor in Judah”: that is our people that is going to remain.

“And Ekron as a Jebusite”: put Ekron on the map. Ekron is still Amalek, Esau, Edom, and Ekron shall be as the Jebusites were. They are going to be smitten, brought down, destroyed, wiped out.

That is why the ADL comes into this lesson. The ADL was formed in 1913, and they put themselves up like some civil rights group. Oh no they’re not. They say they go after hate speech, but was it not hate speech to try to blame the black man? They call it defamation; we call it truth. They don’t want nobody to tell the truth of who they are. Their calls to action have mobilized public opinion against black leadership for decades: they have always been against black leadership, from Marcus Garvey all the way up. And when Congress took up anti-Semitism, the Democrats wanted them found innocent, because they use that as a whipping stick.

precepts.why:
What does it mean, “Ekron as a Jebusite”? Go to the Jebusites. “And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David’s soul, he shall be chief and captain.”

Read on: “So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.” The Jebusites were smitten and their stronghold taken, and David dwelt in it.

So when Zechariah says Ekron shall be as a Jebusite, it is saying they are going to be smitten, brought down, destroyed, wiped out, while he that remaineth, our people, shall be for our God and as a governor in Judah.

Even the white man’s own book says it. Michael Bradley, a white man, an Edomite, not a black guy, wrote that the problem with the world is caucasoid behavior, caucasoid values and caucasoid psychology: the problem with the world is white men. He said it; I didn’t have to say it. He wrote that the Jews of Europe played the same role in our enslavement, oppression and colonization as the other Europeans, and that poorly informed blacks don’t know it; black Christians out there think the white man in Israel today is the Israelites of the Bible. He wrote that they are descended from Caucasus converts to Judaism, with no genetic or historical connection to Palestine at all. They are not the people of the book. When God said ‘two manner of nations’ should be separated, he meant that thing: their DNA should be similar to ours, but it ain’t. Two different types of people. In time they wanted our identity.

And he wrote that Israel was established by deceiving the rest of the world. That is this scripture: “And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world.” These people have deceived the whole world. You think a spirit is the one doing it? Them spirits you are thinking about work through people that deceive the whole world.

“He was cast out into the earth”: that is what we are reading in Zechariah; they are going to be brought down. “And his angels were cast out with him”: his angels are his allies. America is going down too.

The book says particularly the North American public was deceived. That is why, when we travel, people say Americans are the dumbest. We live in a bubble of lies: CNN, BBC, NBC, ABC. Compared to other nations, we’re stupid.

The book said the problem with the world is white men, and there is a scripture that outlines that perfectly. “The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet”: when this bastard goes down, the whole earth is going to be at rest. And I am calling them bastard because those are holy words; that is in the Bible, we read it earlier.

“They break forth into singing”: the whole earth is going to break forth into singing. The birds, the trees, everything is going to be happy.

“Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.” Listen to what they are going to say: since your behind is taken out, no feller is come up against us, because you was the damn devil of everything. Since you are gone, everything else is rejoicing.

The ADL has always been against black leaders. Marcus Garvey started in America in 1916 and was arrested in 1923; the ADL was started in 1913. He was convicted of mail fraud: I wonder who’s behind that. Garvey blamed Jewish people: the ADL was back there at that time. That is what they are about, the destruction of our people, because the ADL know that we are the real Jews. The FBI director started at the FBI in 1924, at 29 years old, ended in 1972, and worked with the ADL. Asked what was the single greatest threat to the USA, he answered negro unity. That is the ADL’s motto as well.

We are not joining Muslims; I just like the way Farrakhan explained this. The same people that say they are our friends were behind the slave trade, and we just read that: the white man said it, it ain’t coming from Farrakhan. Farrakhan gets a point for that; that was some good stuff right there.

So we have to go back to this: “Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie.” They’re a bunch of liars.

“Behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet”: this ain’t happened yet; this is a prophecy yet to come. “And to know that I have loved thee”: the world is going to know that God loves us and only us, the twelve tribes of Israel.

sense.text:
“And I will encamp about mine house because of the army”: what is he talking about? This is why it must be precept upon precept. Some prophets write things so abbreviated you don’t really get it, and you have to go to another prophet who goes in more detail. When them armies surround the land of Israel, the Lord is going to come down.

He doesn’t really describe here what he is going to do, but the verses before, verses four, five and six, talk about the Lord wiping out Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron and Ashdod. He didn’t forget the thought when he got down to verse eight.

“Because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth”: him that passeth by is the other nations; him that returneth is us. We are the ones returning. That goes back to verse seven, “but he that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah”: that’s us.

“And no oppressor shall pass through them any more”: the Lord is going to make sure of it. None of the other nations, no Arabs, no …, shall oppress us or pass through us anymore.

precepts.why:
Joel goes in more detail about the army: “I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.”

They parted the land of Israel between the Palestinians and the … who call themselves Israelis; put it on the screen. That is the land being parted, and that is the army of all nations the Lord encamps about his house because of.

That army is also spoken of here: “And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.”

The kings of the east are the Arabs and the Iranians, and it also includes China. When them armies surround the land of Israel, the Lord is going to come down.

What does “for now have I seen with mine eyes” mean? “And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them.”

Because of the covenant he made with our ancestors, he will always have respect unto us. The scriptures say the Lord has no respect of persons, but he has respect for the Israelites that believe on him. Somebody tell a Christian that.

sense.text:
“Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion”: that’s us. We are the daughter of Zion. And “shout, O daughter of Jerusalem” don’t just mean stand there and holler. He’s telling us to shout and teach. Shouting ain’t just screaming; we’re shouting saying something, we’re shouting about the praises of the Lord.

“Behold, thy King cometh unto thee”: we’re telling the people that the king is coming, the king is coming, ‘repent for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.’

Why does it describe him, “he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass”, when Christ would have already come and gone? Because when you talk about the king coming, our people got a difference of opinion. Some people say Muhammad is coming; based on what we just read, this ain’t talking about Muhammad. Some say Buddha is coming; some tell the black man he can save himself. So the verse gives us the attributes of the coming King, so we can identify him in what we shout. He’s telling you who the king is.

precepts.why:
Here is the shout: “Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause”, talking about the Israelites. So what are we going to shout and be talking about? “Yea, let them say continually, Let the Lord be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.”

“And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.” See that: when we’re shouting, it’s our tongue speaking of his righteousness and his praise. So when we go back to Zechariah 9:9, “Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion”, the shouting ain’t just a scream. We’re shouting about the praises of the Lord.

In case people are confused about who is the king. “And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples, Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.”

“All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.” The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, brought the ass and the colt, “and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.”

So there should be no confusion. When Zechariah tells us about the coming destruction and says the king is coming, and people say to us, well, what king? The king that came riding on the colt, the king that came on an ass. We all know this history.

sense.text:
“And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem”: you might be confused about that, because the tribe of Ephraim is not there no more. Our people are not there. “And the battle bow shall be cut off”: that’s the militaries that’s there. It goes back to verse 5, Ascalon, Gaza, Ekron and Ashdod, and the pride of the Philistines cut off: all this military set up in the land.

The two kingdoms, the northern kingdom and the southern kingdom: those lands are occupied today by the Israelis and the Palestinians. The chariot from Ephraim is the military on the northern kingdom side of the land; the horse from Jerusalem is the military on the southern side. Put up the list of Israel Defense Forces bases: they got a northern command, a central command, a southern; the North and the South taken with military bases. God said, I’m going to cut all that off. All their military is going to be cut off.

“And he shall speak peace unto the heathen”: the heathen he’s going to speak peace to is us, the Israelites, the 12 tribes. If he’s going to wipe them out, the peace is spoken to us.

“And his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from the river even to the ends of the earth”: the Lord’s dominion. That’s us.

precepts.why:
What does it mean that he speaks peace to the heathen? The heathen he’s going to speak peace to is us. “And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.”

We have lived our lives as heathen nations. Whether you call yourself African American, Puerto Rican, Haitian, Jamaican, Trinidadian or Peruvian, we have lived our lives as heathens.

“Thus saith the Lord God; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen”. See that: the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen. We live like heathens, we act like heathens, we dress like heathens; we have become a heathen race of people. So when Zechariah 9:10 says “he shall speak peace unto the heathen”, he’s speaking peace to the Israelites.

About his dominion, the Lord’s dominion. “He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy”: we the children of the needy. “And shall break in pieces the oppressor”: the Lord’s going to break in pieces the oppressor.

People say, y’all just be trying to go for the down and out. Yeah, we are; we go for the poor and needy, because that’s what the Bible tells us to do. That’s who the gospel is for, because the rich and famous of our people say to hell with that Bible. So the Lord said go to them that are low and needy.

“They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.” When God breaks the oppressor, that’s breaking the white man’s power, and they’re going to fear as long as the sun and moon endure. That’s some heavy stuff right there.

“He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth”: that means the Lord and all the chariots with the angels. “In his days shall the righteous flourish”: in the Lord’s days the righteous flourish, that’s us, “and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.”

“He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.” That’s it right there; that’s what Zechariah said in verse 10: “his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from the river even to the ends of the earth.”

sense.text: “As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant”: that’s the New Covenant. “I have sent forth thy prisoners”: we are the prisoners. “Out of the pit”: out of the valley of the shadow of death, out of that great city wherein their dead bodies laid strewn. “Wherein is no water”: meaning the word of God doesn’t flourish here. So he’s going to bring us up out of here.

“Turn you to the strong hold”: the stronghold is the Lord. In other words, return to this Bible. That’s what our people don’t want to do, because there’s so much perversion in the world; all these Christian and Catholic and Islamic religions have perverted the words of this book. So the Lord says, regardless, turn to it, because now his men are out in the highways and hedges.

“Ye prisoners of hope”: we the prisoners of hope.

“Even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee”: the Lord said he is going to render double unto us. When is he going to do it? That’s verse 13, “When I have bent Judah for me”. And the double means he’s going to give us power.

precepts.why: What is the blood of the covenant? “Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant”. See that: through the blood of the everlasting covenant. That’s the New Covenant, and yes, we are under the New Covenant. Stop listening to people who say we’re not under the New Covenant; the stupidity has got to stop.

The breaking of bread, where Christ said take, eat: “And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body. And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it; For this is my blood of the new testament”.

So why would we drink this wine, which is symbolic of us being under the New Covenant, if people say we ain’t under it? It is shed “for many for the remission of sins.” If they’re not under it, their sins are not remitted, and that means they got to go back to the sheep and the ox and the bull.

“After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.” As often as you drink it, in remembrance. So how do you remember Christ? He said by doing this you’re doing it in remembrance of me.

Don’t waste your time arguing with the BHI. That tells me a lot of these BHI are not following what this says; you’re not following Christ. You’re waiting for somebody else to come and die for you in the future.

This was not just done on Passover. Here they break bread daily: “And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart”. Breaking bread from house to house. That’s why Christ says as oft as you do this, do it in remembrance of me; it wasn’t just on Passover.

Some people read that scripture and say no, that’s Catholic stuff. The Catholics stole it and perverted it.

They say we’re not under the New Testament. Really? Go read this: “Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament”. So we’re ministers of the New Testament, but we ain’t under it? It makes no sense. Stop listening to them, brothers and sisters.

“Not of the letter”: not of the old covenant of animal sacrifice. “But of the spirit”: the spirit of Christ, the New Testament. “For the letter killeth”: the old covenant of animal sacrifice kills, “but the spirit giveth life”: the New Covenant in Christ gives life.

The rest of the Old Testament laws are still in effect; it’s only the laws of sacrifice that was done away with.

“And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament”. Wait a minute: Christ is our mediator between us and the Father for the New Testament. Either the Bible is wrong or the BHI don’t know what the hell they’re talking about.

“That by means of death”: Christ’s death, his sacrifice, “for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament”. Who was under the first testament? The Israelites, the 12 tribes of Israel; that’s us. “They which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.” So we are under the New Testament.
“Turn you to the strong hold.” What is the Lord? “The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.” So the stronghold in Zechariah 9:12 is the Lord.

We are the prisoners of hope. “But this is a people robbed and spoiled”: we’ve been robbed, we’ve been spoiled. “They are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses”. It’s telling you here that we are all hid in prison houses. It’s literal too; our people are literally in there. But the prison houses, metaphorically, are these political groups we’re in, these religious groups we’re in, and America as a whole, this land of our captivity.

“They are for a prey”: we are a prey for the nations; they prey upon us. “And none delivereth”: there’s no nation that stands up on our behalf, even Africa does not stand up on our behalf. “For a spoil, and none saith, Restore.” Who goes before the UN and says, restore everything that y’all stole from them? Not one nation on earth speaks up for us in the UN. Not one.

“Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?” Talking about this time. “Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the Lord”: did not the Lord allow that to happen to us, “he against whom we have sinned?” We sinned against the Lord, “for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.”

“Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not”: our people don’t understand. “And it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.” All the hell we catch, and our people still don’t realize why it’s happening to us. It is the Lord from on high that is allowing this to happen to us. We keep looking to other things, but the Most High is the one that is allowing this to happen.

sense.text:
“When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim”: he’s going to fill the bow, so that means the two kingdoms are going to come together. (Put the bow and arrow up on the screen.)

“And raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece”: there will be a war. God will turn us loose against the nations. And why does he say Greece? Because that’s the beginning of the white man’s power. The Greek Empire was the beginning of their world supremacy. God said, I’m going to raise you up against the sons of the Greeks.

“And made thee as the sword of a mighty man”: that’s the double the Lord speaks of at the bottom of verse 12, “I will render double unto thee”. He’s going to give us power. We’re going to be transformed.

“And the Lord shall be seen over them”: this is how you know the time. The Lord shall be seen over us, so we ain’t doing this on our own; we ain’t no crazy Negroes. This is on that side, when we’re changed in the twinkling of an eye. “And the Lord God shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south”: the whirlwinds are the chariots.

“The Lord of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour”: we’re going to devour the nations, “and subdue with sling stones”: we’re going to subdue the nations with sling stones. “And they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine”: it’s going to seem like we’re drunk, rejoicing, because they’re going to be like dust, like paper to us; we’re going to break through them so easily. “And they shall be filled like bowls”: we shall be filled like bowls.

“And the Lord their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people”: we’re going to be the flock of God’s people. “For they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land”: we’re going to be like an ensign on the Lord’s land.

precepts.why:
Judah bent and the bow filled with Ephraim: the hatred is going to stop. That’s unity; the words of this Bible are going to create and manifest unity amongst the 12 tribes.

“The envy also of Ephraim shall depart”. Why? Because we’re on the street teaching love thy neighbor as you love yourself, which is the second great commandment, and unless our people abide by that, they ain’t going to be saved. “And the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off”: the nations.

“Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.” So we know prophetically that hatred is going to end, and it’s ending; we’re seeing it now.

He said he’s going to render the double unto us. “Fear not, thou worm Jacob”: right now we don’t look like much. They say y’all talk loud, you ain’t saying nothing really. Okay, but the angels are activated. We’re a worm right now; we ain’t got no power. “And ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the Lord”: the Lord is going to help us, “and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.”

Here comes the double: “Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument”. That’s the sword of a mighty man we read about in Zechariah 9:13, “made thee as the sword of a mighty man”. “Thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff”: we’re going to beat down all the governments round about us.

“Thou shalt fan them”: we’re going to fan the nations, “and the wind shall carry them away”: the winds are going to carry these broke nations away, “and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the Lord, and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.”

We’re going to be lifted up as an ensign upon his land. “For Zion’s sake will I not hold my peace”: for Zion’s sake the Lord will not hold his peace, “and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth.” That brightness and that lamp that burneth is talking about Christ.

“And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness”: the Gentiles shall see our righteousness, “and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the Lord shall name.” So we argue over language right now? Y’all being simple and stupid, arguing on the street corners: ‘I got a new name for y’all.’ What the hell is wrong with you? You speak English; teach in English. Damn, a Negro can’t understand that thing.

“Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the Lord”: that’s how precious we are, his jewels, “and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.” That is the stones of a crown in Zechariah 9:16.

“Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken”: right now we are a forsaken people, a nation not desired. “Neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate”: our land has been desolate for a long time, desolate of us. “But thou shalt be called Hephzi–bah, and thy land Beulah”: Hephzibah means my delight is in her; we’re going to be called God’s delight. Beulah means married. “For the Lord delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married”: our land is going to be married.

“Thus saith the Lord of hosts; In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew”: a real Jew, “saying, We will go with you”. The nations are going to humble themselves and say we will go with you, “for we have heard that God is with you.” Because we’re going to be that ensign upon a nation, upon a land, “lifted up as an ensign upon his land.”
